entries.title: Saudi Exchange holiday announcements
entries.notes: Each available announcement states the last trading day before and the first trading day after an Eid closure, and the observed date of National Day and Founding Day. The live archive lacks the 2020 Eid al-Adha notice. The 2027–2029 Eid dates are published in advance "according to the Umm al-Qura calendar" and are treated as CONFIRMED.

entries.title: Royal Decree changing the weekend to Friday–Saturday
entries.notes: The Saudi Exchange's first Friday–Saturday weekend was 28–29 June 2013. Before that the weekend was Thursday–Friday.

entries.title: Tadawul to close 7 days for Eid Al-Adha holiday
entries.notes: Contemporary report that attributes the closure and 5 August resumption to Tadawul; corroborates the exchange's own notice (tadawul-eid-al-adha-2020-notice).

entries.title: إعلان السوق المالية السعودية (تداول) بشأن إجازة عيد الأضحى المبارك (Announcement regarding the Eid al-Adha holiday), market news ct-marketnews-20200630-ann4, 30 June 2020
entries.location: https://web.archive.org/web/20200927164532/https://www.tadawul.com.sa/wps/portal/tadawul/markets/Press-Release/news-details/?urile=wcm%3Apath%3A%2Ftadawul_ar%2Fsa-tadawul%2Fsa-pricesandindeces%2Fsa-news%2Fsa-marketnews%2Fct-marketnews-20200630-ann4 (Internet Archive capture of 27 September 2020 of the exchange's notice; the exchange's own @TadawulFeed tweet of 30 June 2020 linking to it is archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20200630122416/https://twitter.com/TadawulFeed/status/1277939985925181441)
entries.notes: The exchange's own notice (Arabic): "يتوقف التداول بنهاية يوم الثلاثاء 7/12/1441 هـ (حسب تقويم أم القرى) الموافق 28/7/2020 م - يستأنف التداول بعد الإجازة يوم الأربعاء 15/12/1441 هـ (حسب تقويم أم القرى) الموافق 5/8/2020 م" (trading stops at the end of Tuesday 28 July 2020 and resumes Wednesday 5 August 2020), so the exchange was closed Wednesday 29 July through Tuesday 4 August 2020 inclusive. It was published as a market-news item rather than on the website's Holidays events page, which is why the live calendar never listed it. Corroborated by Argaam (argaam-tadawul-eid-adha-2020) and by SAMA's identical banking holiday.

entries.title: إجازة اليوم الوطني للسوق المالية السعودية (تداول) (National Day holiday of the Saudi Stock Exchange), market news CT-marketnews-20200910-Ann, 10 September 2020
entries.location: https://web.archive.org/web/20201003211015/https://www.tadawul.com.sa/wps/portal/tadawul/markets/Press-Release/news-%26-announcements/?urile=wcm:path:/Tadawul_en/SA-Tadawul/SA-PricesAndIndeces/SA-News/SA-MarketNews/CT-marketnews-20200910-Ann (Internet Archive capture of 3 October 2020; the exchange's @tadawul tweet and graphic of 16 September 2020 are archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20200916093736/https://twitter.com/tadawul/status/1306164877497643008)
entries.notes: The exchange's own notice: "إجازة اليوم الوطني سوف تكون يوم الأربعاء 6/2/1442 هـ (حسب تقويم أم القرى) الموافق 23/9/2020 م. ويستأنف التداول بعد الإجازة يوم الخميس 7/2/1442 هـ ... الموافق 24/9/2020 م" (the National Day holiday is Wednesday 23 September 2020; trading resumes Thursday 24 September 2020).

entries.title: Holidays (events calendar) of the Saudi Stock Exchange (Tadawul), archived captures 28 June 2020 to 20 February 2021
entries.notes: The exchange's Holidays page as it stood during 2020: it carries the Eid al-Fitr 1441 entry ("Trading will discontinue at the end of trading day 21/5/2020. Trading will resume after the holiday on 31/5/2020.") and no other 2020 closure. Together with the two archived market-news notices above (Eid al-Adha, National Day) and the complete set of 2020 market-news items captured by the Internet Archive, which contain no further holiday notice, this establishes the 2020 scheduled closures as complete: Eid al-Fitr 22-30 May, Eid al-Adha 29 July-4 August, National Day 23 September. COVID-19 shortened the session (10:00-13:00 from 26 March to 30 May 2020) but closed no day.
